### RepoObjectIDSelector
RepoObjectIDSelector is a selector for selecting a range of objects by their treeish.


| Field | Type | Label | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| base_repository | [github.spokes.types.v1.Repository](../../v1/repository.md#github.spokes.types.v1.Repository) |  | <p>base_repository is the parent of this repository.</p> |
| oid | [github.spokes.types.v1.ObjectID](../../v1/object_id.md#github.spokes.types.v1.ObjectID) |  | <p>oid is the object to select.</p> |
